v1.1_evidence_namespace.description: Zen Mesh v1.1 evidence directory — the canonical current evidence namespace. The global baseline scope is sandbox_ci and carries the frozen-green baselines (L1 Foundation, L2 Connect, Traffic V1.1 engine) plus verified-current and subordinate capabilities. All v1.0 evidence artifacts require re-validation per the supersession contract before use in v1.1 claims; superseded evidence must never be treated as current authority.
